bearerAuth.description: The full admin token, or the read-only token on read routes. Errors use the admin error envelope.

peerAuth.description: The read-only peer token; accepted on the peer listener only

streamAdminAuth.description: Dedicated stream-management token; never the ordinary admin token

parameters.description: Records to return, newest first; defaults to 64
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Only failures for this key name
parameters.name: key

parameters.description: Only failures for this stream name
parameters.name: stream

400.description: limit is not 1..=64, a flag is repeated, or a name is empty or invalid percent-encoding

get.summary: Recent key failures, newest first, from an in-memory ring

age_seconds.description: How old the figures were when sent; readers judge freshness by it plus their own time since receipt, not by observed_at

failures.description: Counts of recent key failures by class over a bounded in-memory ring, newest or not; never bodies, key names or streams

gateway.description: Only with expose_usage; aggregate gateway counters, counts only

host.description: Optional non-core extension: present only with expose_host_stats; off by default

items.description: Figures are null for a role whose filesystem could not be queried in time

observed.description: Passthrough upstreams observed by the publisher; always present, may be empty

reiki_version.description: The publisher's version, sanitised for terminal display

requestlog_export_dropped_total.description: Summary records dropped by the bounded queue or failed syslog sends; present when the request-log export reports drops

sessions.description: Optional non-core extension: present only with expose_host_stats; streams only with expose_key_labels too. Counts are client-reported and can be inflated by a token holder. Off by default

active_sessions.description: Client-reported distinct values of session_header in the window, not a count of verified devices
Client-reported distinct values of session_header for this stream

streams.description: Only with expose_usage; aggregate stream counts

capacity_group.description: Opaque, operator-set group for this upstream; only when [upstream.NAME] capacity_group is configured, never derived from a key label or response

cooling_combinations.description: How many (route, model) combinations are cooling on this upstream's keys; a count only, never names

cooldown_class.description: Only while cooling, and only when the class is known; readers ignore unknown values

quota_reset_at.description: RFC3339 UTC reset behind a quota cooldown, when the key names a reset schedule or the response supplied Retry-After; only for a cooling quota key

state.description: available, cooling, out_of_rotation; readers ignore unknown values

last_status_class.description: 2xx, 4xx, 5xx, or null before one; readers ignore unknown values

limited_1h.description: Attempts that were rate-limited or began a cooldown in the last 60 minutes; only with expose_usage

request_buckets.description: Twelve five-minute attempt counts, oldest first, newest last; only with expose_usage

request_minutes.description: Ten one-minute attempt counts ending at the current minute, oldest first, newest last; only with expose_usage

requests_1h.description: Attempts in the last 60 minutes; only with expose_usage, a count only

soonest_cooldown_seconds.description: Rounded up to a multiple of cooldown_bucket_secs, unless it is 0

token_buckets.description: Twelve five-minute token counts, oldest first, newest last; only with expose_usage

token_minutes.description: Ten one-minute token counts ending at the current minute, oldest first, newest last; only with expose_usage

tokens_1h.description: Input plus output tokens of the responses served by this upstream in the last 60 minutes; only with expose_usage

429.description: Too many failed peer logins from this address

get.summary: Coarse key health per upstream, for peers

servers.description: The peer listener; these routes are not served on the admin listener

429.description: Too many failed logins, or max_subscribers_per_peer streams open from this address, or max_subscribers_per_token with this token
